name: Aluminium
description: Live-performance modules for MIDI controllers: keyboard splits, expressive pad voices, and labeled faders and buttons driven by MIDI or the mouse alike, so a patch stays playable with or without its controllers plugged in.
author: Neil Baumberger

modules.name: Zones
modules.description: Keyboard split and mono voice allocator for a polyphonic MIDI-CV signal (V/OCT, GATE, VELOCITY, AFTERTOUCH, RETRIGGER): two note-range zones, each polyphonic passthrough or monophonic with note priority (last/highest/lowest note) and true legato gate. Duo mode reproduces the Moog Subsequent 37 / Sub 37 DUO mode: duophonic/paraphonic two-voice allocation, highest note on B, other held note on A, with per-note velocity and poly aftertouch

modules.name: Pads
modules.description: 16 gate outputs, one per learned note, driven by a polyphonic V/OCT + GATE cable (e.g. from Core MIDI-CV or Zones) instead of MIDI — learn a cell by clicking it and playing (or typing) the note; each cell can be switched to Latch mode to toggle on/off instead of following the held note

modules.name: PadX
modules.description: Pads expander: extracts a freely-labeled polyphonic lane (e.g. Velocity, Aftertouch, Retrigger) into 16 mono outputs, one per note Pads has learned

modules.name: Fader
modules.description: Labeled vertical fader with a CV output in a selectable unipolar or bipolar range, and a CV input (e.g. a MIDI CC, read in its own range) that moves the fader itself, like a motorized fader on a digital mixing desk: whichever of the slider or the input moved last wins

modules.name: Faders2
modules.description: Two Fader columns side by side, each with its own label, output and input ranges, input takeover threshold and light color (set from its slider's right-click menu)

modules.name: Faders4
modules.description: Four Fader columns side by side, each with its own label, output and input ranges, input takeover threshold and light color (set from its slider's right-click menu)

modules.name: Buttons
modules.description: Two labeled lit buttons, each with a gate/trigger input acting as a remote press: Momentary or Latch gate output, or Toggle trigger mode (input trigger passed through, light tracks a downstream trigger-driven switch's state); selectable on and off light colors
